name: How much does a workers' compensation lawyer cost in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: How much does a workers' compensation lawyer cost in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: In San Diego, workers' compensation lawyers typically work on a contingency fee basis. This means you generally do not pay upfront fees. Instead, the lawyer receives a percentage of the benefits they recover for you. The fee percentage is set by the state's Workers' Compensation Appeals Board (WCAB) and is usually between 10% and 15% of your final settlement or award. This arrangement allows injured workers to access legal representation without immediate financial burden.
acceptedAnswer.description: Workers' compensation lawyers in San Diego usually work on a contingency fee basis, taking a percentage (10-15%) of your settlement.
